blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A sweeping 24-hour police dragnet across Northern Mindanao resulted in the capture of six of the region’s most wanted fugitives, including a top-tier murder suspect and multiple individuals facing sexual abuse charges. Police units in Bukidnon, Misamis Oriental, and this city carried out the coordinated warrant operations on Friday and Saturday. Brig. Gen. Nestor Babagay Jr., Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) director, ordered the intensified crackdown to bring individuals with standing warrants before the courts.
